## Ingredients

- 8 oz shrimp, peeled and deveined
- ¾ cup shelled edamame
- ¼ cup dry brown rice (about ¾ cup cooked), or a precooked pouch
- 1 bell pepper, sliced
- 1 cup snap peas
- 1 head bok choy, stems and leaves separated
- 2 tablespoons low-sodium soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon sesame oil
- Neutral oil, for the pan

## Instructions

1. Cook the brown rice, or reheat a precooked pouch.
2. Heat a wok or large pan over high heat with a splash of oil. Sear shrimp about 2 minutes per side, then remove.
3. In the same pan, add bell pepper, snap peas, bok choy stems, and edamame. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes.
4. Add garlic, ginger, bok choy leaves, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Return the shrimp and toss 1 minute.
5. Serve over rice.

## Notes

- Total time assumes a precooked rice pouch. Dry brown rice adds about 45 minutes.
- Rice portion (¾ cup cooked) is a floor. Bump to a full cup on heavy training days.
- One serving lands around 45–55 g protein plus fiber.
